name: Aeonx Digital Technology Limited
about: Aeonx Digital Technology Limited operates as a software technology and cloud company in India and internationally. The company offers business solutions, including RISE with SAP, GROW with SAP, SAP AMS, AWS, Google Cloud, and Multi-cloud CMS. It also provides SupplierX, OrderX, Xpense, LogystiX, ManufeX, and AXOIM AI Platform. It serves the manufacturing, mining and minerals, energy and oil and gas, textiles, FMCG and distribution, automotive and aerospace, and alliances industries. The company was formerly known as Ashok Alco-Chem Limited and changed its name to Aeonx Digital Technology Limited in December 2023. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India. Aeonx Digital Technology Limited operates as a subsidiary of Aura Alkalies And Chemicals Private Limited.
